Covers' Osborne also leaned Under 42.5, which is the same take. The skeptical view is that the total has already dropped from 48.5 to 39.5, so the obvious Under may be priced in.
discovery.question: Has the total settled near 39.5 or lower? Could Jacksonville get close to it alone? It scored 73 points in its last two games and Baltimore allowed 71 in its last two.

discovery.hypothesis: Covers' published pick is a Strange anytime touchdown, which isn't one of our markets, so this direction asks whether his target volume carries over to receptions. He has seen seven or more targets in three of his last four games, and Baltimore has allowed six touchdowns to tight ends. The main risk is that Jacksonville barely throws if it controls the game: Trevor Lawrence completed only 10 passes in Week 8.
discovery.question: If Jacksonville leads early, will Lawrence throw enough for Strange to clear his receptions line, or will they run out the clock?
